session.name: MPI-622 session 23 - Phase 4 built, Fabio's UI pass applied, and the seed bug that blocked every VC run

goal.original: Start Phase 4 - wire MpiVoicePicker into the voice-changer flow's 'Target voice' slot, after asking Fabio what emotion means in that flow.
goal.summary: PHASE 4 IS BUILT, TWICE - the wiring, then Fabio's UI pass on top - and shipped as fc0aecc8 (16 files). Every question the last handoff left open is answered. The one thing still not done is the phase's actual gate: a real generation. It could never have worked before this commit, because generateRandomSeed() returned seeds ~23,000x larger than FL_ChatterboxVC accepts, so Voice Changer had NEVER completed a run from the app on any machine. That is fixed; the run itself needs Fabio.

completed: THE LIBRARY IS WIRED as a THIRD SOURCE inside the existing MpiMediaPicker overlay on 'Target voice', beside Upload and Record - NOT a second button next to the slot, because the slot's 'exactly one job' was a deliberate earlier repair. Opted in PER SLOT by one index-aligned field on the flow's media group: `voiceLibrary: [null, 'character']`, which carries the opt-in AND the preview route together. Slot 0 ('Your performance') gets no voice card by design - a stock voice is not the thing the user performed.

A PICKED VOICE IS FETCHED, DECODED TO WAV, AND ROUTED THROUGH `_handleFiles`, so it lands as an ordinary content-addressed project asset with zero new injection plumbing. It is NOT passed through as .opus: `opus` appears in exactly ONE of the five extension lists that classify a file as audio (routes/projects.js:90) and is missing from js/utils/file.js AUDIO_EXTS plus three more lists in routes/projects.js. That is the same trap that made MpiAudioRecorder re-mux its WebM, so that recorder's `_toWavFile` is now exported as `toWavFile` and reused - a library pick and a recording reach the graph as the same kind of file.

EMOTION IS ANSWERED and it is NOT audition-only. Fabio: in the TTS flow it is a real final-stage dropdown. The mechanism, corrected in the same exchange and worth keeping: VC does not ADD emotion. The dropdown picks a PERFORMANCE CLIP, TTS speaks the text with that clip's delivery, and VC then swaps the voice while carrying that delivery through. Voice Changer has no TTS stage, so the user's own recording already carries the emotion. New `emotions` prop (default true); the VC mount passes false. The `select` payload omits `emotion` whenever the control never showed.

ALL FOUR FILTERS AND THE BADGES ARE GONE. Fabio: 'we don't have that many voices to even think of filters at this point. I think if they're properly organised, that's more than enough.' On the kind badge: 'I don't even know what badge you're talking about' - which IS the answer, since it read 'both' on all 56 rows. Gender and age badges went too: the group heading now says both.

THE SECTIONS ARE DIVIDED INTO EIGHT DEMOGRAPHIC GROUPS - `VOICE_GROUPS` + `listGroups()` in js/data/voiceLibrary.js. Fabio picked option A: the demographic is ORDERING and holds whole SECTIONS. Option B (the demographic replaces the section, flattening its voices) was rejected because Standard Female and Mature Female both land in 'Mature female' and are NOT one voice - B would re-make the claim his ear rejected in Phase 3. `adult` and `mature` share one group; children are not split by sex; `Character` catches the three sections with no gender and no age. His silence on where those three go was taken as agreement, per his convention.

AN UNKNOWN `age` NOW THROWS, and the bug it catches was already live in the repo. A section is placed by declared gender+age; an age matching no group falls to `Character`, where a deep male voice would be unreachable now that the groups ARE the navigation. `null` stays legal (that is how the three Character sections get there). The Phase-1 test fixture was carrying `age: 'midage'` and the gallery fixture `age: 'young adult'` - neither value exists in the shipped manifest, and both would now throw. Both corrected.

FABIO'S UI PASS, all five items, each measured live rather than eyeballed: (1) the panel was letterboxed AND had two scrollbars, one cause - it was `position: absolute; inset: 0` over a grid that is one row tall in an empty project, and both it and the picker's `max-height: 360px` list scrolled. Now in flow (grid + filter tabs hide) with the list as the only scroller; measured panel 518px, list 400px, exactly one scrolling element. (2) Clicking a row now selects AND plays - the 32px play icon was the only way to hear anything. (3) Switching rows stops the previous one, measured as play A -> pause A, play B; re-clicking the playing row stops it. (4) The confirm button is a pinned footer, always visible, disabled until something is selected - it used to be a detail PANEL that appeared on selection and moved. (5) A filled AUDIO slot is a hover-to-play box, not a filename: every flow input is content-addressed, so that name was always a sha256 and told the user nothing about which voice they had picked.

THE SEED BUG - and Fabio guessed it was a stale app needing a restart, which it was not. `FL_ChatterboxVC failed: ValueError: Seed must be between 0 and 2**32 - 1`. `comfyController.generateRandomSeed()` returned up to 1e14, ~23,000x the node's ceiling, so the odds of any run landing in range were about 1 in 23,000. Voice Changer had NEVER completed a generation from the app, with any target voice, on any machine - and it is unrelated to this card's wiring. Capped at 2^32-1, the widest range every node accepts (core samplers take 64-bit seeds and were simply never the ones to object). Guarded by tests/seed-uint32-range.test.cjs, which also pins the graph wiring so the cap cannot silently stop protecting this flow.

VERIFIED: npm test 747/747, npm run test:desktop 29/29, eslint clean, and two live probe rounds against the REAL flow in an isolated instance - slot 0 offers Upload+Record only, slot 1 offers all three, the library renders 8 groups / 15 sections / 56 cards with 0 filters and 0 badges, no emotion control, the play button builds /voices/<sample>.opus (200), and confirming writes a real RIFF/WAVE of 1,005,612 bytes.
pending: THE PHASE'S ACTUAL GATE, AND THE ONLY THING LEFT: a real generation. Fabio opens Voice Changer, records or uploads a performance, picks a library voice as the target, presses Generate, and a gallery card lands. It has never succeeded once - the seed bug made it impossible - so this is genuinely unproven end to end, not merely unwitnessed. Phase verify mode is `user-ux`.

THE BRITISH-ACCENT QUESTION from session 22 gets its first real test on that run. Fabio reports VC sometimes produces a British accent and that re-pressing Generate re-rolls it. A previous session argued VC carries the user's own accent and cannot invent one; he reaffirmed from listening. HIS EAR WINS - do not re-argue it, just listen when there are real runs to hear.

THE SEED FIX IS IN MPI-607'S FILE TERRITORY (js/services/comfyController.js is not on its files.json, but the voice-changer flow is its card). Its session is stale - heartbeat 2026-08-23, far past the 120-minute timeout - so there was no live claim, and the bug was blocking THIS card's gate. Worth a line to that card at close-out.
MEMORY.md is over the hook's compaction target. Needs Fabio's confirmation per the global rule before any entry is removed or merged - do NOT do it unilaterally.

key_decisions: FABIO'S REVIEW CONVENTION: he names ONLY what he dislikes. Silence means approved. Misreading this cost session 18 an entire gate. It applied again this session - he answered 'A' on the grouping without addressing where the three genderless sections go, which was taken as agreement with the proposed Character group.
A MEASUREMENT IS NOT A PERCEPTUAL VERDICT - this card has now paid for it EIGHT times. When his ear and a number disagree, the number is wrong until proven otherwise.

EMOTION IS A TTS-STAGE CONTROL, AND VC DOES NOT ADD EMOTION. It preserves the source delivery and swaps timbre. The dropdown picks a performance clip, TTS speaks with that clip's delivery, VC carries it through. This is the answer to a question raised three times across three sessions - do not reopen it.

A GROUP IS ORDERING, NEVER A SECOND GROUPING LEVEL. Two sections under one demographic heading are two DIFFERENT voices. Flattening them would re-make the 'these are all one voice' claim Fabio's ear rejected in Phase 3.
GENDER AND AGE ARE DECLARED, never inferred from audio. An f0-based villain split was proposed in session 22 and was wrong on two of five.

WHEN A USER GUESSES AT A CAUSE, CHECK IT RATHER THAN AGREEING. Fabio asked whether the generation error was just a stale app. It was a real bug that would have failed on any machine, and agreeing would have sent him to restart and hit it again.
constraints: PEER SESSIONS ARE LIVE IN THIS TREE and commit to master. Commit by explicit pathspec, never `git add -A`. Left deliberately uncommitted this session: .claude/settings.local.json, dev_configs/smoke-run.txt, MPI-596's events.jsonl, and the state/sessions/*.json churn.

HEREDOCS ARE BLOCKED by guard-shell, and so is a backslash-newline continuation - both fire as PreToolUse errors. Write the commit message to a file and use `git commit -F <path>`; write multi-step shell or PowerShell to a scratchpad file and run it by path.

KILL YOUR OWN APP INSTANCE BY VERIFIED PID, never by name pattern: an agent instance and Fabio's live app share the byte-identical `electron.exe .` command line. Walk ancestry with Get-CimInstance Win32_Process - MINE has parent `node scripts/launch-instance.mjs`, HIS has parent `cmd /c electron .` and owns :3000. Confirm :3000 answers 200 afterwards. TaskStop kills the LAUNCHER only and leaves the app orphaned holding the agent profile.

NEVER PIPE THE LAUNCHER THROUGH `grep -m1` OR `head` - the pipe closes on first match and SIGPIPEs npm, killing the app. Launch it bare in the background and poll its output file with an `until grep -q READY` loop.

AUTOPLAY IS BLOCKED in a headless probe, so a real `.play()` REJECTS and the picker resets its own playing state - which makes the click-to-play branch untestable. Stub `window.Audio` with a fake whose `play()` resolves; that is the only way to observe the real path rather than the rejection path.

A TEST FIXTURE CAN CARRY A VALUE THE SHIPPED DATA NEVER HAD and stay green for years - the voice fixture's `age: 'midage'` and the gallery's `age: 'young adult'` were both invalid and both invisible until validation was added. When adding a check, run it against the SHIPPED manifest too, not only the fixture.
ALWAYS take the GPU through gpu_lease.py, and stop asking permission per run - Fabio's standing position, 2026-08-26. Nothing here needed it.
%TEMP% IS NOT SAFE STORAGE - Windows temp cleanup deleted a 145 MB working cache mid-session on this card. The voice source corpus lives at C:/Users/Fabio/AppData/Local/cubric-vision/mpi622/lib_v2.
